· Significantly below SMA100 (242,086 KRW)/SMA200 (238,332 KRW): Deepening mid-to-long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (25.9%): Approaching historical low levels, a phase for exploring rebound potential.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.9→33.9): Entered oversold territory, exploring potential for a rebound signal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-328.3230→-1262.7452): Continued worsening, signaling strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band 168,098 KRW): Approaching the lower band, requiring support confirmation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (167,300 KRW): Above Pivot S1 (144,133 KRW), expected to act as a short-term support.
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): Breakthrough could signal a short-term rebound trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (5-day low 170,000 KRW, 20-day low 170,000 KRW): Sideways range confirmed, potential for Lower High formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.30x): Movement has momentum, increasing reliability if direction is confirmed.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to RSI oversold entry and weak ADX trend; consider buying after confirmation of support at 167,300 KRW.
